notes: Flags: none. The play mat for the rug-free variants (F-61 asks for 'a play rug or mat'; the family may skip rugs for dust and mites, 2026-10-24). 47 1/4" square, 16 sq feet, smaller than the 70-79 x 50-71" the brief asked for. Materials and care: 'Fabric: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)', 'Surface coating: 100 % Polyurethane', 'Filling: 100% polyester (min. 60% recycled)', 'Button: ABS plastic'; care 'Hand wash warm water.', 'Do not tumble dry.'. The page does not say it wipes clean; the wipeable tag rests on the polyurethane surface coating. Quilted, beige. Its eyelet fastenings fold the edges up into a toy box ('A mat, play area and storage box – three functions in the same product!'). Designer Lukas Bazle. 4.6 stars (9). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY; click and collect free (2026-10-24). Amazon's search for a foam play mat hit a bot wall on 2026-10-24, so no foam mat was read. rooms: living-room, maddie-room, from the rug-free brief.
